pages.title: Blink
pages.text: $(bold)Necklace:$() grants Dolphin's Grace.$(br2)$(bold)Bangle / Ring:$() teleports you to whatever you are looking at — or, with nothing in view, as far ahead as the way is clear.$(br2)$(bold)Cooldown:$() 4.0s per cast.$(br2)$(bold)Held by:$() Engravable Ender Pearl.
